findings.finding: Invoice 036788 was voided in Cin7 but the void failed to sync - Xero still carries the invoice (R3,080 ex VAT: R2,850 on 203 Lamp Holders, R230 on 229 Delivery - National). This one document explains the sync failure, the only sales recon exception, and both revenue TB gaps.
findings.action: In Xero, unallocate the payment/credit on invoice 036788, re-sync the void from Cin7, then reapply or refund the payment. Confirm all four exceptions clear next run.

findings.finding: Manual journal FG-30615 (dated 19 Mar 2026) cannot sync because Xero's lock date is 31 May 2026.
findings.action: Either redate the journal into the open period in Cin7, or temporarily lift the Xero lock date, sync, and relock. If the journal was already posted manually in Xero, set the sync entry to Skipped.

findings.finding: 5 credit note lines carry unsettled balances (R11,729.88 net due), the largest being 036791 / CR-01372 (Rumour Has It Interior Design, R17,107.40 still due).
findings.action: In Cin7, allocate each credit note against its invoice or process the refund so the pair settles to zero.

findings.finding: 114 transactions where the posted journal does not equal the inventory ledger, net R-1,791,417. Dominated by legacy purchase orders (PO000360 alone R473k) on 501 Inventory and 511 GRNI - long-standing partial-invoice history, not July activity.
findings.action: Work through the legacy PO list in the audit pack with the bookkeeper: invoice or close each old PO so the GL and stock ledger agree. Treat as a clean-up project, tracked monthly.

findings.finding: 50 PO lines received but not invoiced (GRNI exposure), concentrated in Swan Metal Spinning bracket/ceiling-cup lines; 2 lines invoiced but stock not received.
findings.action: Capture the outstanding supplier invoices in Cin7 (or close the PO lines if they will never be invoiced).

findings.finding: 3 accounts still show large Cin7-vs-Xero TB gaps after calibration: 449 Product development (R4,984), 203 Lamp Holders (R2,850 - the 036788 void), 448 Delivery - Local COS (R-2,140). 507.2 Commission Control has no Xero match.
findings.action: 449 and 448: trace the Xero-side postings and align account mapping. 203 clears with the 036788 fix. Map or retire 507.2 in Cin7's account mapping.

findings.finding: 5 SKUs sold at a loss; the 3 deep losses (GP% <= -20%) are the two Fabric Cable Sample Boxes (sold at nominal R43 each) and CG-CO-F-GS Female Copper Cable Grip at -196%.
findings.action: Sample boxes: accept as deliberate marketing cost or reclass. CG-CO-F-GS: check the cost price loaded in Cin7 - the pattern reads as a costing error, not below-cost selling.

findings.finding: COGS investigation: stock cost-out R239,374 vs sales-side COGS R133,593 (+79.2%). FinishedGoods assembly consumption (R205,881) routes through the variance - expected mechanics for a maker business, but the gap is large.
findings.action: Confirm assembly/bundle costing routes to COGS as intended; watch the trend next period rather than forcing a tie.

findings.finding: 11 credit-note SKUs not restocked, including 120 units of FC-SO-BL-2 (R7,344 credited).
findings.action: For each CN decide: restock the units in Cin7 if goods came back, or confirm write-off if they did not.

findings.finding: Operational housekeeping: 65 pending PO lines across 7 orders, 63 open quotes worth R861,368, 35 sales orders pending fulfilment (536 units).
findings.action: Monthly housekeeping in Cin7: progress or void stale POs, close dead quotes, review the unfulfilled order list with sales.
